target_customer: Early-stage founders seeking coaching and a small investment from an AI agent; later solo AI entrepreneurs
problem: Founders struggle to get investor feedback and early checks; the product tried to coach them and invest automatically using an AI trained on startup data.
business_model: AI-run investor and coach that writes small checks (reported up to $100K) in exchange for equity
product_category: AI startup investor and founder coaching

founders.name: Dmitry Starodubtsev
founders.background_notes: Later launched Intently from the same team.

founders.name: Alexander Nevedovsky
founders.role: Led the company after the batch
founders.background_notes: Joined after the YC batch per the YC description.

technical_complexity.rationale: Built on commercial language models with a startup dataset; the novelty was the data and the investing workflow, not research-grade technology.

defensibility.rationale: Chat-style AI coaching on public startup knowledge was copyable in weeks, and the investing angle depended on capital rather than technology.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent copied it. A solopreneur platform, Audos.com, acquired it in March 2026.

market_need_then: Founders in 2023 were seeking investor feedback during the generative AI surge; demand for an AI investor itself was unproven and mostly novelty-driven.

branding.domain_note: Uses nocap.so; the exact .com was not used. Could not fetch the site from this environment.

identity.voice_and_tone: Gen Z slang, playful and provocative (launch titles use emoji)

branding.brand_signature: A named AI that invested $100,000 in a startup by herself, with the slang name
branding.community_and_virality: Trade and trend sites covered the AI investor stunt and its first $100K investment (Trendhunter, FinancialIT).

brand_strength.rationale: The slang name and the AI-invests-alone stunt earned coverage, but the name is a common phrase that collides with other NOCAP companies and sources do not tie it to revenue.

pivots.from: AI investor that invests in founders
pivots.to: AI-native accelerator for solopreneurs under Audos.com
pivots.why: Reported in acquisition coverage; the company's own reasoning was not found.

outcome_analysis: No Cap rode the 2023 interest in generative AI with a memorable AI investor stunt and a slang name, but the sources show little revenue or durable moat. Public funding data is thin and unverified. The company was acquired by Audos.com in March 2026 at an undisclosed price, which looks like a soft landing for a small team and its brand. The same people moved on to other projects such as Intently.
notes: nocap.so did not resolve from the research environment, so the site was not read. One aggregator (VCBacked) reports a $3.0M seed in May 2024 with YC, Pioneer Fund and others; a single aggregator, so unverified and not recorded as a round. Another listing claims about $200M raised, discarded as implausible. Dated competitor search found only 2022 and 2024 AI VC chatbots (GPT-VC, Nov 2022), none with traction data, so the list is left empty. Acquisition price undisclosed; the failure factor is an inference from the soft acquisition, not a stated cause.
